product_name_specific: Chandni Whitening Cream, Removes Acne, Wrinkles Pimples, Dark Spots & Dark Circles
risk_description: The product poses a chemical risk because it contains mercury (measured value: 15590 mg/kg). Mercury accumulates in the body and can damage the kidneys, brain and nervous system. Additionally, it may affect reproduction and the unborn child.
legal_provision: The product does not comply with the Cosmetic Products Regulation.
